tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.our_fair: Jacksonville 82.5% / Baltimore 17.5% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline); spread fair Jacksonville -10.5 47.5%
games.take: Thursday night in Baltimore is all about the quarterback room: Lamar Jackson is out (IR, thumb surgery) and Tyler Huntley is out (toe), so undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano makes his first NFL start against a 5-2 Jacksonville team that scores 28.0 points per game and allows 15.9, second-fewest in the league. Baltimore has lost three straight and gives up 25.4 per game. The market has moved from 7.5 to 10 on the quarterback news and the number is about right now — no US price clears our 0.75% bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. Weather is a non-factor: cloudy, around 71°F at kickoff, with only a light rain chance late. No true edge here, but the lean is Jacksonville to win outright because Baltimore is starting a third-string rookie quarterback against the league's second-stingiest scoring defense.
games.title: Thursday Night Football: Jacksonville @ Baltimore
games.verdict: LEAN: Jacksonville — no true edge at -550, but the lean is Jacksonville to win because Baltimore is starting a third-string rookie QB against the league's second-stingiest scoring defense.
games.weather: Cloudy, ~71°F at kickoff, light rain possible late; no NWS alerts

games.our_fair: UTSA 70.2% / Florida Atlantic 29.8% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline); total fair Over 49.3% / Under 50.7%
games.take: A Thursday shootout in Boca Raton: 7-1 UTSA, 4-0 in the American, visits 5-3 Florida Atlantic, which is unbeaten at home this season, with a total of 72.5 — one of the biggest numbers of the year. Florida Atlantic's passing attack meets a UTSA defense that grades poorly in coverage, and both teams have been involved in high-scoring games all season. No US price clears our 0.75% bar on the side or the total, so this is a lean, not a board play. Weather is a non-factor — near 80°F and mostly clear. No true edge here, but the lean is Under 72.5 because 72.5 is a huge number and the Under is the least-bad price on the board at -110 (fair 50.7%).
games.title: Shootout in Boca: UTSA @ Florida Atlantic
games.venue: Flagler Credit Union Stadium, Boca Raton, FL
games.verdict: LEAN: Under 72.5 — no true edge, but the lean is the Under because 72.5 is a huge number and the Under is the least-bad price at -110.

games.matchup: James Madison Dukes (7-2) @ Southern Miss Golden Eagles (3-5)
games.our_fair: James Madison 84.0% / Southern Miss 16.0% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: 7-2 James Madison heads to Hattiesburg off back-to-back losses, visiting a 3-5 Southern Miss team that has won two straight but owns the 136th-ranked run defense in FBS, allowing 223.4 rushing yards per game — against a James Madison ground game at 202.0 yards per game. The spread has trimmed from 15.5 to 14.5, but the moneyline is where the market is wrong: FanDuel hangs -500 while Pinnacle is -568 and DraftKings is -575. That beats the devigged Pinnacle fair and clears our 0.75% bar, so this is a real board play — thin, labeled honestly, and priced off the number. Weather is perfect football weather: clear skies, 65°F.
games.title: Dukes look to get right at Southern Miss
games.verdict: LEAN: James Madison — a real edge, not just a lean.

games.our_fair: Phoenix 50.2% / Orlando 49.8% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline); total fair Over 48.3% / Under 51.7% at 223.0
games.take: Two slow starts meet in Phoenix: the 1-5 Suns are on the second night of a back-to-back after losing 132-119 to Portland, with the league's worst defense at 124.3 points allowed per game, while the 2-5 Magic have had two days' rest but are without Paolo Banchero (ankle) and Jalen Suggs. Phoenix's three home games have averaged 250.3 combined points, so the market's Over lean is understandable — but our fair at Pinnacle's 223.0 already has the Under at 51.7%, and no US price clears our 0.75% bar at a matched point. No true edge here, but the lean is Under 223.5 because our fair already favors the Under at 223.0, and FanDuel's extra half-point to 223.5 is worth roughly the push mass.
games.title: Tired Suns host rested Magic
games.verdict: LEAN: Under 223.5 — no true edge at a matched point, but the lean is the Under because our fair already favors it at 223.0 and FanDuel's extra half-point helps.

games.our_fair: Golden State 71.1% / Miami 28.9% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline); spread fair Golden State -7.0 49.8%
games.take: Rest is the story in San Francisco: 5-3 Golden State has won five straight and had two days off, with Stephen Curry averaging 30.0 points per game, while 3-5 Miami is on the second night of a back-to-back after an overtime win at the Clippers, 117-116. Golden State is without Kristaps Porzingis, but the Warriors are 5-3 for a reason and the market has them as a 7.5-point favorite. No US price clears our 0.75% bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge here, but the lean is Miami +7.5 because the half-point at -110 is the cheapest cover probability on this board, even with the back-to-back working against them.
games.title: Rested Warriors host tired Heat
games.verdict: LEAN: Miami +7.5 — no true edge, but the lean is Miami +7.5 because the half-point at -110 is the cheapest cover probability on this board.
